propositions: run_git_write does not retry write-side temp-file faults (ENOENT/EINVAL) because _with_transient_fault_retry matches only READ-side markers, causing s3_doctor and other non-event_append callers to fail on transient runner-FS blips while event_append self-heals via its private _with_transient_add_retry

write-side fault signatures ('unable to create temporary file', 'failed to insert into database', 'unable to index file') are duplicated in event_append._TRANSIENT_ADD_MARKERS and not recognized by the shared seam, creating an asymmetric protection gap

moving the write-side marker family into gitutil and consolidating retry logic under a single _with_transient_fault_retry loop unifies the retry budget and ensures all run_git_write callers inherit bounded retry of transient write faults
corrupt-object signatures ('loose object ... is corrupt', 'inflate: data stream error') must remain excluded from retry to surface genuine persistent faults

nested composition of _with_transient_head_retry and _with_transient_add_retry gave commit paths an accidental 3×3 attempt budget; collapsing to a single _with_transient_fault_retry restores the intended bounded 3 attempts
